verses: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.
Lord, Thou hast been favourable to Thy land: Thou hast brought back the captivity of Ya῾aqov.
Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. (Sela.)
Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath: Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thy anger.
Restore us, O God of our salvation, and cause Thy anger towards us to cease.
Wilt Thou be angry with us forever? Wilt Thou draw out Thy anger to all generations?
Wilt Thou not revive us again: that Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
Show us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us Thy salvation.
I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace to his people, and to his pious ones: but let them not turn back to folly.
Surely his salvation is near to them who fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
Love and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Truth will spring out of the earth; and righteousness will look down from heaven.
The Lord moreover shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield its increase.
Righteousness shall go before him, and walk in the way of his steps.
